intent.description: Evidence-backed reflection contract for products delivered by Frontier HVE creator modes.

hooks.recommendation: Have each CLI or API feature check save its output to .harness/evidence/<feature>/<name>.log; for a remote service, save a pulled log excerpt there.

rubrics.description: The delivered product implements the requested user-visible outcomes end to end.
criteria: Every requested core workflow is usable without placeholder behavior.
Edge cases named in the request have explicit behavior.
The output starts and operates in its intended environment.

rubrics.description: The output follows the stated stack, scope, non-goals, and repository rules.
criteria: User and repository constraints are satisfied without silent substitutions.
No unnecessary infrastructure, dependency, or scope expansion was introduced.
Errors and missing configuration surface clearly.

rubrics.description: Claims about correctness are supported by current deterministic checks and inspectable artifacts.
criteria: Locked feature checks pass against the delivered output.
Evidence was produced by tools or hooks rather than model narration.
Evidence is specific enough to reproduce or inspect.

rubrics.description: The primary workflow is understandable, responsive, keyboard-usable, and visually legible.
criteria: The main action and system state are clear without documentation.
Interactive controls have labels, focus behavior, and non-color-only meaning.
Responsive layouts preserve the workflow at common viewport sizes.

rubrics.description: The output avoids unsafe behavior, hidden failure, fragile coupling, and unjustified complexity.
criteria: Trust boundaries and user-controlled input are handled safely.
Failures are explicit and do not become success-shaped defaults.
The implementation remains within repository size and structure constraints.

roles.mandate: Search for concrete misses, regressions, unsafe assumptions, and evidence gaps that should block release.
Weigh delivered value against the contract and distinguish blocking defects from acceptable trade-offs.
Identify the smallest high-leverage revision that would make the output clearer, safer, or more complete.
